subject.title: ci(qa): reuse Matrix live workflow for releases

question: Should the release/CI owner require a successful hosted workflow_call run for this exact stacked head before merging the workflow consolidation?
rationale: The source and contract tests support the design, but only an owner can accept static/Testbox proof for release automation or require GitHub-hosted proof of cross-workflow ref, output, environment, and status semantics.

options.title: Require hosted exact-head proof
options.body: Run the reusable Matrix release profile through GitHub Actions on the exact stack head and confirm status propagation, artifacts, and release-summary behavior before merge.

options.title: Accept contract proof
options.body: Accept the focused Testbox suites and workflow static guards as sufficient after the dependency lands and required checks become green.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold this PR and its cleanup successor until the dependency and release-check failures have a stable landing sequence.

recommendation.title: Require hosted exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Run the reusable Matrix release profile through GitHub Actions on the exact stack head and confirm status propagation, artifacts, and release-summary behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the visible migration stack and have maintained the exact workflow and validation contracts under review.
